# preact-components: the exports of the @spy4x/preact-* packages on JSR, one per line.
# Columns, separated by one tab: name, kind, import specifier, summary.
# Search: git grep -n -i '<word>' origin/main -- llms.txt
# Use: deno add jsr:<package>, then import { <name> } from "<import specifier>".
# Left out: a type or interface that describes the parameters of a listed function or class Foo, foo or createFoo and is named Foo plus Props, Labels, Options, Config, Deps, Input. Its signature: https://jsr.io/<package>/doc
# Full READMEs: https://spy4x.github.io/preact-components/llms-full.txt
BarDatum	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	
Bars	component	@spy4x/preact-charts	Server-rendered horizontal bar list — the "Top N" chart.
ChartPayload	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	
DEFAULT_AXIS_COLOR	constant	@spy4x/preact-charts	Axis and frame line colour.

DEFAULT_TEXT_COLOR	constant	@spy4x/preact-charts	Axis label and legend text colour.
DEFAULT_TRACK_COLOR	constant	@spy4x/preact-charts	Track colour behind a bar or an empty donut ring.
DateRange	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	Data layer for the chart components: the shape a stats endpoint is expected to return, the loader that validates it, and the date-range maths a comparison panel needs.

InViewRef	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	`useInView`'s `ref`: a callback ref that also keeps the element in `current`.

KpiGrid	component	@spy4x/preact-charts	Responsive grid for `Kpi` cards: two columns on a phone, as many as fit on a desktop.
KpiTone	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	Colour role of a `Kpi` value.

NiceScale	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	
TIME_FRAMES	constant	@spy4x/preact-charts	The bucket granularities a series can be aggregated at.
TimeFrame	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	Bucket granularity of a series.
TimeSeriesPoint	type	@spy4x/preact-charts	
barPercent	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Percentage of the longest bar, clamped to `[0, 100]`.
chartPayloadSchema	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Payload of a stats loader: the points plus the granularity they were bucketed at.
createInViewObserver	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Observe one element and report intersection changes.
donutGeometry	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Slice maths for `DonutChart`: cumulative shares plus the `conic-gradient` string.
extent	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Finite-only `[min, max]`, or `null` when nothing is plottable.
linearScale	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Map a domain onto a pixel range.
loadChartPayload	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Call a stats loader and validate what it returns.
niceScale	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Padded, rounded-outward domain plus the tick values that go with it.
niceStep	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Round a span up to a sensible tick step at roughly `target` ticks.
paddedDomain	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Pad a domain by a fraction of its span, so points never sit on the axis frame.
previousPeriod	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	The window before `range`, ending exactly where `range` starts.
seriesColor	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Pick a palette entry for a series index, wrapping around and tolerating a negative index.
ticks	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Tick values at multiples of a nice step, kept within half a step of `[min, max]`.
timeSeriesPointSchema	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	One bucket of a time series, as it arrives from an API.
useInView	hook	@spy4x/preact-charts	Report whether the element behind `ref` has scrolled into view.
xLabelStride	helper	@spy4x/preact-charts	Draw every `stride`-th X label and always the last one, so a dense axis keeps a readable label count without dropping the right-hand end.
CHART_PALETTE_CLASS	constant	@spy4x/preact-charts/colors	Classes a chart puts on its root so `DEFAULT_CHART_PALETTE` resolves to the light steps, or to the dark ones under a `.dark` ancestor — the theme package's class-based dark mode.
cn	helper	@spy4x/preact-cn	Join conditional class names and resolve conflicting Tailwind utilities.
join	helper	@spy4x/preact-cn	Join conditional class names, with no Tailwind conflict resolution.
ArchiveConfig	type	@spy4x/preact-crud	The archive toggle: a checkbox in the footer that stamps `deletedAt` through the update the form already submits, plus whatever has to be archived first for it to be allowed.
ArchiveToggleState	type	@spy4x/preact-crud	What the archive toggle changes: the soft-delete column, and what blocks it.
AssociationActions	type	@spy4x/preact-crud	The two writes an association editor performs outside the form's own submit.
